annotations.title: Put a set of App Store screenshots in order

description: Sets the order of one App Store screenshot set (one language and device size): setId and every screenshot id of the set, each once, in the order they should appear, from ploa_listing_get with that language. Only on a version being prepared. Google Play keeps images in the order they were uploaded: there, remove them and upload again in order. Needs a token allowed to submit.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

ids.description: Every screenshot id of the set, first to last.

name: ploa_screenshot_order
title: Put a set of App Store screenshots in order
